notes: Each neighbour is worked as its own operation: ordinals as a successor sequence; Laws of Form as the literal U/M oscillation step sequence plus Varela third value; Gödel as the fixed-point ladder; group completion as the two contrasts ℕ→ℤ (injective) vs {0,e}→trivial (collapse). No neighbour is allowed to lend its theorem to the native relation; the body of each scene states the boundary. SOURCE DELTA: census receipt hashes for matheme-fde-catuskoti, matheme-kauffman-iterants and matheme-noether-symmetry-conservation are stale — those three files changed at source commit 5c22906 (before the census snapshot was taken from an earlier state); bindings record the current sha256 at dbf3b17 (working tree clean, verified). E0 should reconcile the census receipt.

Per-scene moves (2026-10-06 enrichment): every sequence walks its proof order with objectState marking exactly three moments — blue at contrasts/intermediate steps, red where a fallacy or collapse is named, gold at the derived arrival (slightly swelled). fn-von-neumann-ordinals: the ladder grows by enclosure (tint deepening to gold at |n| = n). fn-division-pluralisms: the shared-zero equation tempts cancellation (red ?), then each pluralism named (blue), gold at the total declaration. fn-sheffer-stroke: AND and OR rebuilt from strokes, gold at functional completeness; vortex pointer — one generator turning the whole table. fn-laws-of-form-varela: U/M alternation tinted at every flip under a 'beat' morph — the delay is the oscillation; dispersion LFO breathes it. fn-russell-types: red at the biconditional (shove click — the rupture), blue at the typed repair, gold at 'no issue'. fn-godel-incompleteness: the proof order only — arithmetisation, fixed point (blue), two unprovabilities, second theorem gold; low pointer strength and no metaphysical movement anywhere in the scene. fn-fde-catuskoti: the four values hold repel forces in a grid; the tables sequence tints at paraconsistency and at e ≠ n. fn-crt-z6: the isomorphism and its inverse under implode (two moduli, one ring). fn-trivial-ring: 'sum'-law morph — everything sums to one; red at the assumption, blue at the collapse step, gold at one element. fn-grothendieck-group-loss: two sequences side by side — ℕ→ℤ arrives gold (nothing lost), {0,e}→trivial arrives red (the loss). fn-kauffman-iterants: [a,b]→[b,a] physically swaps position, i² = −1 gold; vortex/vortex is the iterant alternation. fn-cross-ratio: the invariance step deliberately keeps its objectState identical (invariance shown, not said), then swap (blue) and squares (gold). fn-qubit-bloch-sphere: THE 3D SCENE — |0⟩ north, |1⟩ south, |+⟩/|−⟩ equator, the mixtures note inside the sphere (dome volume, perspective, laminate layout): the state space itself is the third dimension, and the two-opposites seam is written on the board. fn-noether-symmetry-conservation: the driven-balance sequence keeps its rotational charge gold. fn-quaternion-q8: the lattice walk marks noncommutativity blue (ij=k · ji=−k). fn-calculus-infinity-dx: the family widens (scale up), C pinned blue, the integral gold. fn-chaos-attractors: basins attract to ±1 while the boundary repels; bifurcation sequence to gold.

Craft: pointer profiles by meaning — attract/pulse for constructive derivations (ordinals, Sheffer, calculus, cross-ratio), attract/implode for gatherings (CRT, trivial ring), vortex for generators and alternations (stroke, iterants, Bloch axis, Noether symmetry, Q8), repel for held-apart values and fallacy guards (division pluralisms, FDE corners, Russell shove, chaos boundary). Automation: dispersion LFOs on von Neumann, Laws of Form, CRT. Durations 12/14 s and transitions 1.5/2.0/2.2 s differ. Discipline kept per orienting principle III.6: Gödel does one exact formal job — the scene's decoration is proof order, not metaphysics; softmax discipline's sibling here is that no neighbour is absorbed into the native relation (each scene's own guard text survives in its record body and glyphs).

What the third dimension means (fn-qubit-bloch-sphere): the qubit's state space IS a sphere — rays at the poles, equatorial superpositions, mixtures in the interior — so the scene is genuinely 3D: |0⟩ and |1⟩ at z ±0.45, |+⟩/|−⟩ on the equator, the purity note inside the dome volume under perspective. Rotation about the axis (vortex pointer) shows the relative-phase freedom; the board states the seam — antipodal r are orthogonal rays while ±ψ is one ray — the exact neighbour's agreements and differences both kept.
